description: BecomeTECH is a team focused on devoloping innonative technologies in the fields of software development,artificial intelligence,data analysis and 3D visualization.By combining our crative perspectives, we aim to produce sustainable solutions to space and earth-related problems.Within the scope of the NASA Space Apps Challenge,we aim to develop solutions to real-world problems using NASA data and to enable individuals around the world to learn about problems and possible solutions through this.
